newsitem.title: USA: Astec Industries sees charges, Q4 loss.
newsitem.headline: Astec Industries sees charges, Q4 loss.

text.p: Astec Industries Inc said Friday that its 1996 operating results will not meet analysts' expectations and will result in a fourth quarter loss.
Wall Street had been expecting the company to earn $0.23 per share in the fourth quarter and $0.90 per share for full year 1996, according to First Call consensus estimates.
The company said its 1996 earnings will be about equal to its 1995 results.
The company's fiscal 1995 results were $0.45 per share, said corporate Controller F. McKamy Hall.
The company said it expects fourth quarter charges, related largely to its Trencor subsidiary.

The company declined to give an estimate of the charges, but said they will cover the discontinuance of a new product, increases in inventory reserves and legal costs for settling two liability lawsuits against Trencor.
The company said the moves should enhance future profitability, adding that its backlogs as of December 31 were higher than at year-end 1995.
The company plans to release results around February 21.
